eye_style_baseline.drawing_rule: Use the user-preferred G02-01 upper-lash and eye-shape construction. Trial a single solid dark-charcoal iris fill, retaining small white glints; no iris gradients or multiple gray bands.
eye_style_baseline.expression_rule: Eye opening, expression and gaze follow each current original PV frame. Do not impose the reference's half-lidded state on every pose.

eye_style_baseline.isolated_under_eye_dot: Remove obvious isolated decorative cheek/under-eye moles. User permits tiny eye-corner short marks like approved G51-10 whole EYES_white_5x, even with a small pixel gap; do not reject solely for separation. Preserve real lashes/liner, own source expression and tiny nose/mouth marks.

hair_flat_color_rule.rule: The bob and added drill share the same unlit flat PV rendering. Use one uniform ash-gray hair fill, one uniform muted mint structural band color and black outline/coil separation lines. No specular white glints, white streaks, glossy reflection, ambient/rim lighting, airbrushed gradients or volume-shadow panels on the drill. Hair volume means contour and coil geometry, never lighting. The mint stripe is material color, not reflected light.
hair_flat_color_rule.reference_priority: The polished original identity controls head/drill geometry and bead attachment only; its lighting, white sheen and shaded coil underside must not transfer. Original PV and current flat drawing guide control rendering.
hair_flat_color_rule.review: Check bob and drill together, including inside broad turns. Keep evidence of older shaded candidates and reopen affected selections; a silhouette or attachment pass does not accept their lighting.

drill_anatomical_side_rule.reference: Original identity front/profile/rear, never AI-video attachment side
drill_anatomical_side_rule.left_facing_profile: left side is near; original near-side bead/drill may be visible
drill_anatomical_side_rule.right_facing_profile: right side is near; anatomical-left bead/drill is on FAR side and is hidden according to original bob/nape/shoulder geometry. Do not attach it to the visible near-side ear to keep it visible.
drill_anatomical_side_rule.motion_boundary: Hair may swing or rebound without changing which anatomical side owns its root. AI video may itself violate this and never controls laterality.
drill_anatomical_side_rule.repair_boundary: Keep original PV facing/action; redraw visible character coherently, no mirrored whole body or hair collage.
drill_anatomical_side_rule.front_three_quarter_views: Both front three-quarter views keep the fixed anatomical LEFT root on viewer RIGHT. In a right-facing three-quarter turn it is FAR and may be hidden; do not copy the original twin-tail or AI near-ear attachment onto viewer LEFT.
drill_anatomical_side_rule.prompt_projection_helper: scripts/DanceHairSideRules.py, current view spelled out before reference roles; prompt constraints still require actual returned-image review.
drill_anatomical_side_rule.oblique_view_rule: Pure-front/pure-rear screen-side mnemonics never certify an oblique head turn. Resolve torso/head orientation and near/far occlusion separately; right-facing rear-three-quarter15 has anatomical LEFT farther and must not inherit a complete near-back left-screen coil overlay.
drill_anatomical_side_rule.mandatory_first_sentence: 辫子固定在人物自身的左侧，不是画面左侧；正面通常位于画面右侧。人物转到侧面或背面时，仍保持同一个解剖左侧的低耳后发根，按当前转向和遮挡投影，不能换边或镜像人物。

hair_motion_reference_boundary.rule: Dance drill placement follows the moving head, shoulder and original gesture, with elastic swing, compression and rebound. Preserve anatomical attachment and intrinsic hair mass; never freeze a vertical spiral or impose equal root-to-tip/head-height ratios across changing poses. Foreground arms may hide the lower coil; do not pull a complete coil onto an arm merely to show its tip.
hair_motion_reference_boundary.reference_role: Latest explicit user boundary 2026-11-01: the AI video is ONLY a secondary reference for hair swaying, elastic bounce and rebound. All character action, hand/arm/body/head pose, expression, gaze, costume, framing and exposure/PTS come from ORIGINAL PV. Retarget hair motion to that original pose; the AI video's body/head motion, timing or identity drift cannot replace it or justify extra character actions. Original character identity and flat rendering references remain authoritative. Generated artifacts and undersized segments are not new identity requirements.
